subject: english
prompt: A survey of 20 students finds that 15 prefer reading. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text: In this survey, 15 of the 20 students preferred reading.
Every student in the city prefers reading.
Reading is objectively the best activity.

answer.explanation: The conclusion stays within the surveyed group and reported result.
